releaseNotes:
- New help requests and SOS alerts now arrive instantly on nearby volunteers (same design, both roles)
- Real-time connection is now reliable: the app reconnects automatically after a drop, on every resume, and after logging in again
- Volunteer location is kept fresh in the background so nearby requests are always delivered to you
- Volunteer home stays active in the background when you switch tabs - you never miss a new request
- One unified bottom navigation bar with identical design, icons and behavior on both Volunteer and Help Seeker sides
